critical_code_review_comments: Workflow fix is correct and minimal: comments at lines 28/298/307 still contain the words '--with-deps' / 'apt-get' for context — this is intentional and only in comments; naive grep for those strings in the file will match comments, so any CI guard must grep active (non-comment) commands only.
Scenario B fallback runs `timeout 240 npx playwright install chromium` without --with-deps — correct; relies on preinstalled system libs on ubuntu-24.04 runners, which hold chromium's deps already.

hydration_guard.mjs correctly separates exit 2 (bad config) vs exit 3 (no browser launched) vs exit 1 (real failure); step script handles rc==3 only on the fallback branch after reaching it from the Chrome branch (good: preinstalled-Chrome failure falls through to download fallback instead of skipping).
